findings.title: current-key fallback still reachable when IPaymentIntegrationSettings is absent
findings.expected: binding always recorded; callback verified only against a persisted per-order key
findings.actual: binding skipped entirely; initiate and webhook sign/verify with the current options checksum key; GetTrustedWebhookChecksumKey remains with no production caller
findings.impact: latent fail-open; report's absolute no-fallback claim inaccurate

findings.title: binding insert does not enforce provider order code belongs to the referenced payment order
findings.trigger: non-null trusted PaymentOrderId for a different existing order with no prior binding
findings.expected: numeric order code validated against the referenced order before insert (approved proposal)
findings.actual: row inserted linking provider code X to order Y; post-check compares only PaymentOrderId; no DB constraint ties the columns
findings.impact: caller-trust based instead of FK-enforced; not exploitable by the only current caller

findings.title: inventory aborts on a single unsupported non-numeric order code
findings.trigger: any payment_orders.order_code that is not numeric
findings.expected: flag that row and continue paginating
findings.actual: InvalidOperationException aborts the whole --inventory run with exit 1
findings.impact: pre-deployment inventory step can be blocked

findings.title: no immutability trigger on checkout_signing_bindings
findings.actual: insert-only convention plus ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and unique index only

findings.title: CLI usage errors exit 1 instead of documented exit 2
findings.trigger: --offset/--limit parse failure, missing value after --manifest, conflicting switches

findings.title: RequireOutsideRepository passes when no .git ancestor exists
findings.trigger: tool run outside any git work tree
findings.impact: low; source builds sit inside the repo

findings.title: PG helper .env fallback strips double quotes only
findings.trigger: single-quoted SMARTPARK_DEV_PASSWORD used through the fallback path
findings.impact: test-infra only; bypassed when the connection string is supplied

findings.title: non-numeric stored order_code cannot be resolved at webhook time (pre-existing)
findings.trigger: order persisted with non-numeric order_code while the provider code is hash-derived
findings.actual: order not found, webhook marked FAILED, collection never applied
findings.impact: pre-existing; narrows the claim that provider-code fallback is preserved

findings.title: platform handlers hardcode null enablement instead of rejecting
findings.actual: value dropped silently, request still succeeds
findings.impact: defense-in-depth only; validator is the sole guard today
